purpose: Committed source of truth for real samples and hardware receipts still required before the four product pillars can be called production-complete.

requirements.why_needed: Closed on 2026-07-01 by the broad old-photo Bayer phase scan, which found real Nikon D200 GRBG fixtures.
required_evidence: original camera raw file, not demosaiced or linearized
SHA-256 source hash
make, model, dimensions, CFA phase, bit depth, black level, white level, and ISO
metadata extraction or inventory receipt
acceptance: Bayer phase fixture inventory reports at least one real parsed GRBG fixture
real fixture compatibility remains passing
stills matrix and capability checks continue to pass for all normal 2x2 Bayer phases

requirements.why_needed: Mission 1 has real still/video fixtures but no production-ready same-ISO darkframe sidecar, so nonzero noise removal/addback must stay disabled for this camera.
required_evidence: at least four true no-scene-signal darkframes under one camera/ISO/CFA/dimensions key
lens/body cap or equivalent no-light capture confirmation
original DNG/GPR paths and SHA-256 source hashes
little-endian uint16 Bayer extraction receipts for every frame
fixed make, model, dimensions, CFA phase, bit depth, black level, white level, ISO, and exposure
acceptance: darkframe candidate audit groups at least four Mission 1 frames under one camera/ISO/CFA key
camera-noise calibration builder emits gpr.camera_noise_calibration.v1 with production_ready=true
sidecar records source hashes, fixed camera metadata, per-plane sigma, and separates_noise_from_signal=true
camera-noise runtime policy enables nonzero denoised targets/noise addback only for exact matching sidecar classes

requirements.why_needed: iPhone CFA DNG compatibility exists, but the current iPhone Linear Raw fixture is a negative fixture and cannot calibrate CFA noise.
required_evidence: at least four true no-scene-signal CFA DNG frames under one camera/ISO/CFA/dimensions key
original DNG paths and SHA-256 source hashes
proof that the files are CFA raw, not Linear Raw
little-endian uint16 Bayer extraction receipts for every frame
fixed make, model, dimensions, CFA phase, bit depth, black level, white level, ISO, and exposure
acceptance: darkframe candidate audit groups at least four iPhone CFA frames under one camera/ISO/CFA key
camera-noise calibration builder emits gpr.camera_noise_calibration.v1 with production_ready=true
camera-noise coverage audit marks iPhone CFA ready
Linear Raw remains rejected as a raw Bayer fixture

requirements.why_needed: Pi 5 stand-in encode and preview paths pass the accepted 20 fps floor, but product readiness requires the same path from the actual Mission 1 sensor/DMA, storage writer, and rear display.
required_evidence: target_preflight_receipt.json
labs_target_bench.json
camera_handoff_receipt.json with target.role=camera
preview_decode_1024x768/receipt.json
preview_ui_receipt.json
mission1_camera_closure_run.json
valid .gvid output with zero dropped frames
timing and memory receipt for sensor/DMA to encode/write and preview handoff
acceptance: closure validator marks camera_production_ready=true
raw 4096 x 3072 Bayer to .gvid clears the accepted 20 fps floor or documents the real camera bottleneck
the same .gvid decodes to full-frame camera-back preview at 20 fps or better
receipts prove the source was real sensor/DMA or camera ring-buffer data rather than a packed original .GPR wrapper

requirements.why_needed: Current near-time high/low pairs are useful diagnostics but produce an unstable native PSF kernel. A PSF-conditioned 4K/8K replacement needs controlled same-scene data.
required_evidence: original high-resolution and low-resolution GPR/DNG paths with SHA-256 source hashes
decoded little-endian uint16 Bayer paths, byte counts, dimensions, CFA phase, and SHA-256 hashes for both sides of every pair
extraction receipt paths and SHA-256 hashes for the high and low decoded Bayer files
settings receipt path and SHA-256 hash proving fixed ISO, exposure, white balance, lens mode, stabilization, sharpening, and lens-correction state
PSF measurement receipt path and SHA-256 hash proving accepted or rejected pair status
fixed ISO, exposure, white balance, lens mode, stabilization, sharpening, and lens-correction state
locked camera and static scene confirmation
negative controls labelled as moved-camera, changed-scene, or mismatched-settings pairs with rejected_by_measurement=true and rejection_reason
acceptance: pair inventory reports at least three decoded native high/low Mission 1 candidate pairs
each accepted pair records 8192 x 6144 high-resolution Bayer and 4096 x 3072 low-resolution Bayer dimensions
decoded Bayer byte counts equal 100663296 bytes for high-resolution inputs and 25165824 bytes for low-resolution inputs
measurement plan selects at least three controlled pairs
native PSF measurement accepts at least three pairs after scene/alignment vetting
accepted pairs provide at least 96 sharp-edge and 96 texture-field tiles
combined kernel has no invalid negative weights and max normalized-weight std <= 0.10
negative controls fail for alignment or scene mismatch rather than tool errors
native_psf_ready_for_model_conditioning=true

requirements.why_needed: The still-SR pipeline, target builders, specialists, and raw-CFA residual trainers exist, but current no-REF models remain diagnostic and do not clear the production still/editor-latitude gate.
required_evidence: checkpoint hash and training config
training target hash with candidate-only runtime inputs
50 MP and 100 MP full-frame raw-domain gates
raw-editor latitude review at exposure offsets
worst-row visual dashboard
editable DNG/GPR output receipts
timing and memory receipt for the offline render path
camera-noise policy receipt proving noise is conditioning or calibrated addback, not source-content leakage
acceptance: candidate beats current still-SR baselines on 50 MP and 100 MP holdouts
no REF/source image content is used at render time
raw-editor latitude review has no severe worst-row failures
noise removal/addback is enabled only for exact camera/ISO classes with validated sidecars
promotion receipt is registered only after the gate passes
